clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore, Wizbang Cranktoggle wants Thresher Eyes for his Buzzboxes. He uses them to repair Buzzbox 411 on the beach north of Auberdine.

Darkshore Threshers hunt the surf and outer shallows off Darkshore. They threaten local fishermen and travelers, and their large eyes have caught the interest of Wizbang Cranktoggle. The gnome engineer is stationed nearby and fond of crawler wine. He needs the eyes to repair Buzzbox 411, a far-speaking communication machine on the beach north of Auberdine.

Wizbang does not explain how the slimy eyes repair delicate machinery. They might serve as crude lenses, chemical agents, or biological gears. Whatever the method, three eyes placed in Buzzbox 411's maintenance hatch restore its communication link, and Wizbang sends supplies through static-choked transmissions.
